mapper.insert: INSERT INTO falconx_market_analytics.kline ( symbol, interval_type, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, open_time, close_time, source ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{intervalType}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{volume}, fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{openTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC'), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{closeTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC'), #{source} )

INSERT INTO falconx_market_analytics.kline ( symbol, interval_type, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, open_time, close_time, source ) VALUES
( #{record.symbol}, #{record.intervalType}, #{record.openPrice}, #{record.highPrice}, #{record.lowPrice}, #{record.closePrice}, #{record.volume}, fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{record.openTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC'), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{record.closeTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC'), #{record.source} )
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, interval_type, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, open_time, close_time, source FROM ( SELECT symbol, interval_type, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, open_time, close_time, source FROM falconx_market_analytics.kline WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND interval_type = #{interval} ORDER BY open_time DESC, ingest_time DESC LIMIT 1 BY open_time LIMIT #{limit} ) ORDER BY open_time ASC
